function.arguments: {"finding": "The email campaign was deliberately targeted at existing high-value customers, as indicated in the data dictionary. This means the email group is systematically different from the paid_search group in terms of customer_segment. Specifically, email has a higher proportion of 'loyal' and 'returning' customers, while paid_search has a higher proportion of 'new' customers. This is a confounding variable because customer_segment is likely correlated with conversion rate. Therefore, comparing raw conversion rates between email and paid_search is invalid — the observed difference may be driven by segment differences, not the campaign type.", "implication": "We cannot report the raw difference in conversion rates as the causal effect.
